newsitem.title: USA: Unocal to sell stake in UNO-VEN for $250 mln.
newsitem.headline: Unocal to sell stake in UNO-VEN for $250 mln.

text.p: Unocal Corp said on Thursday it would sell its 50 percent stake of the UNO-VEN U.S refining operations to Petroleos de Venezuela S.A. (PDVSA) for $250 million by the end of the first quarter of 1997.
UNO-VEN is a petroleum refining and marketing company that markets "76" brand products throughout the midwestern U.S.

The 50-50 partnership between Unocal and PDVSA was formed in 1989. If the transaction goes through, Unocal expects to invest part of the proceeds in upstream and midstream projects overseas and in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico area, the company said in a statement.
UNO-VEN runs a 153,000 barrel-per-day refinery near Chicago, Ill and supplies about 2,500 independently owned "76" branded retail outlets in 15 Midwest and eastern states.
The partnership has 1,100 employees and annual sales of more than $1.2 billion.
The transaction also includes the transfer of a 25 percent interest in The Needle Coker Co from UNO-VEN to PDVSA.
The transaction does not include Unocal's sponge coke or the solvents businesses, the company said. Unocal and PDVSA expect to complete the transaction in the first quarter of 1997.
- A lubricants blending and packaging plant in Cincinnati, Ohio, plus two finished lubricant distribution terminals
- 11 company-owned light oil terminals, an aviation turbine fuel terminal and a commercial network of more than 60 other terminals in 12 midwestern states
